about_the_game:
STORY

Delve into a horror adventure about a man with two personalities. For a long time, Jack, an insecure and bullied since childhood guy, have been struggling with his own life. When everything started to seem bloom, a disaster happened and Jack's personality was split into 2 parts. Old Jack and McKinsey, a psycho side without any borders of good and evil. Jack have got fast: he needs to get rid of it. McKinsey didn't like it. He didn't want to leave this world so soon, so he threatened Jack's family with bloody violence.

Is there any chance to save them? Is there a chance to get therapy, and finally try to establish a happy life? It's up to you.

FEATURES

  • Intriguing narrative with 5 available endings

  • Hallucinations that affect the game: the more you play, the more severe they can become

  • Handcrafted by a solo developer

  • Inspired by the Silent hill vibe

  • Convenient UI to access game-related features on tap, without interrupting the game flow

  • Many locations to explore

  • Your choices do affect the story

  • Narrative based puzzles

GAMEPLAY

In this story-driven adventure game, players will interact with Jack's world and his visions. Go through 7 days and set things up so you can get into therapy, without McKinsey understanding. Interact with other characters who can help you, solve puzzles and act tricky. Otherwise McKinsey won't go easy on you...

content_descriptors.notes: Game content may include: references to suicide, unscientific descriptions of mental illnesses and references to threats.

name: Undesirable Me
short_description: Undesirable Me is a psychological horror in the genre of visual novel and adventure. Fight a psycho within you: solve puzzles, make hard decisions and determine your fate. Who will win and rule the body? It's up to you.
